text:
Yes, according to our plant safety guide, spider plants are on Leafy's pet-safe list, along with calathea, parlour palm, Boston fern and peperomia.

If you're also considering other plants, these are **not** pet-safe: monstera, pothos, peace lily, snake plant, ZZ plant and fiddle leaf fig.

If your cat ever does eat part of any plant and seems unwell, contact your vet or local poison control right away. If you'd like, I can also connect you with a Plant Care Specialist for more advice (chat 9am-5pm Mon-Fri, or email help@leafy.example, answered within 1 business day).
